entities.name: Michael Philipp Daniel Boumann
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Michael Philipp Daniel Boumann was a German master builder and architect active in the Kingdom of Prussia. His father Johann and brother Georg Friedrich were both also architects. Boumannstrasse in Berlin-Reinickendorf is named after him.
